title: vaccinium micranthum
intro: Vaccinium micranthum, commonly known as the small-fruit blueberry, is a type of plant that belongs to the heath family (Ericaceae). This plant has been found to have several health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to protect against chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The therapeutic actions of Vaccinium micranthum include its ability to act as an antidiarrheal and antimicrobial agent, making it useful in the treatment of gastrointestinal disorders and infections. The bioactive constituents of Vaccinium micranthum include anthocyanins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
